mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies at 58 degrees near Verona City Hall. The air quality index is 61, which is in the moderate range. We are currently under a New Moon. The overnight low is expected to be 55 degrees and we are not anticipating any rain overnight.

In city news, the Common Council has adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan. This long-range document focuses on creating strong neighborhoods, supporting our regional employment hubs, and revitalizing our downtown area. The plan is the result of extensive community feedback gathered since late 2024.

We have a full calendar for you. Today, enjoy live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard. Tomorrow, you can catch the Puppets in the Park event at Century School Park or head over to the Dane County Farmer's Market at the Capitol. Additionally, live music is playing at Paddy Mac's tomorrow.
Looking at the police report, on October 3, a 19-year-old man was arrested after officers located a stolen firearm inside his vehicle during a traffic stop for expired registration.
If you are looking for a treat, Culver's is serving OREO Cookie Overload today. They are open until 10:30 PM, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
